rule.statement: The current title registration system in Sri Lanka should be amended to facilitate due diligence and protect the interest of clients, and an identity search should be adopted and implemented along with the title search to avoid fraud.
rule.supporting_quote: The present title registration system in Sri Lanka does not facilitate such a process of due diligence and should be amended to avoid injustice caused to genuine purchasers of land. An identity search as proposed by the amendment of the Law along with the title search, should be adopted and effectively implemented and in this way, fraud as seen in this case can be avoided.
